anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of LEDs D4, D14, and D23. It has no source, driver, pull-up, or connection to +3V3 or any other supply.
anomalies.expected: A net named /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW that feeds LED anodes should be connected to a 3.3 V supply or a driven switched 3.3 V rail so the LEDs can be forward biased. Standard practice for indicator LEDs requires an anode supply path.
anomalies.impact: D4, D14, and D23 cannot light because their common anode net is floating. This would disable the associated Ethernet/activity LED functions while leaving the rest of the board electrically similar.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a connectivity anomaly: the LED power net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW is connected only to the anodes of D4, D14, and D23 and is not connected to any 3.3 V source or driver, so those LEDs cannot operate as intended.
